name: Health: I was absent from my workplace for health reasons, a circumstance I reported immediately to the centre's director
Medical appointment: it was not possible for me to arrange the medical appointment outside my working hours. (Supporting document attached)

Invasive medical test: I was absent from my workplace for the whole day because I underwent an invasive medical test (includes colonoscopy, endoscopy, gastroscopy and catheterisation). (Supporting document attached)

Menstrual or climacteric flexibility: recoverable flexible-hours leave for menstruation or climacteric affecting health (maximum 8 hours during the current month, recoverable in minimum fractions of 30 minutes over the following 4 months).
